_doc: Canonical PRD-lifecycle terminal-phase vocabulary. Single source of truth for Sentinel handlers + Tools that need to classify a PRD as terminal-closed. R-FW-6 (RFC-TBD, ratified 2026-05-18 via /goal sprint after audit PRD 20260518-025157_unchecked-isc-rootcause-framework-audit).

superseded.note: Explicit-abandonment phase; takes closure_reason: exemption path rather than the terminal-gate path. PRDs at phase: superseded SHOULD carry closure_reason: pointing at the superseding slug.

retired.note: Explicit-abandonment phase (scope-cut). Takes closure_reason: exemption path. Zero-progress retired PRDs are Mode A (Scope Abandonment) per the audit.
